overview: Clive Rosfield, the guest fighter from Final Fantasy XVI, fights with a sword and Eikon powers. Wavu Wiki highlights his long range: f+2, f+1+2 and b+1+2 reach far enough to beat most backsways. His lows are risky, and some key pokes such as df+1 barely track.
playstyle: Long-range swordplay. Control the space just outside the opponent's reach with long mids, enter Phoenix (PHX) off many strings to keep the pressure going, and spend Heat on Ifrit-powered follow-ups. Be careful with lows: Wavu notes they are all -13 or worse.

stances.name: Phoenix
stances.entry: F or 4 after 1,1, 2,2, 4,4, b+2, ws1, ws4, f,f,F+2 (on hit or block)
stances.note: His main follow-up stance: PHX.2,1 tornadoes, PHX.1+2 is a Heat Engager, PHX.3+4 is +7 on block. b+2 into PHX is +4 on block.

stances.name: Garuda
stances.note: A combo stance: GAR.2,2 is used in his launch combos.

stances.name: Wolf (Torgal)
stances.entry: From combo enders (see the Move Library)
stances.note: WOL.2 and WOL.3 appear in his combos; WOL.3 is an instant tornado.

To make the opponent respect mids.

i12 string that can enter Phoenix with F or 4.

As a whiff punish and in neutral reads.

Sabaton Smash: i11 while-standing mid, -5 on block, can enter PHX.
Blue Bolt: i17 homing mid, launches on counter hit (+57a).
When the opponent steps or presses.
